stores.name: Lutz Target
stores.pattern: About once a week, Mon/Wed/Thu mornings: Thu 9/17, Mon 9/21, Mon 9/28, Thu 10/1, Thu 10/8, Wed 10/14, Mon 10/19 (~11 AM: ETBs, boosters, blisters, Knockouts; gone ~12:10). Vendor ('she') arrives ~8-9 AM; product out ~10-11:30. Last week she went Lutz (Thu) -> Carrollwood Target (Fri).
stores.window: Next week - Mon 10/26 or Wed/Thu, ~9-11:30 AM
stores.tip: Already stocked this week (Mon 10/19) - unlikely again before next week. 2 per item limit on 10/19. Manager has said he'll trespass anyone lining up before 7 AM. Limits 1-2 per SKU.

stores.name: Gandy Target
stores.pattern: Tuesdays, three weeks running (9/29, 10/6, 10/13). Vendor arrives ~8 AM and is slow; Pokemon often last onto the wall. Employees sometimes pre-stock overnight.
stores.window: Be in line before open; vendor product 8 AM-12:30 PM
stores.tip: Don't crowd the vendor - he has left before when pestered. Leftovers (tins, Gengar AH) often sit by CS into the evening.

stores.name: West Hills Target
stores.pattern: Wednesdays, four weeks running (9/23, 9/30, 10/7, 10/14). Employees at open; vendor ~9:30-10 AM some weeks; sometimes a midday second wave.
stores.window: Wed at open (~8 AM) to 10 AM
stores.tip: Line forms ~7:30. Product often held behind customer service.

stores.name: Waters Target
stores.pattern: Tuesday afternoons, two weeks running: Tue 10/6 ~4 PM (employees, silent) and Tue 10/13 ~3:56 PM (vendor, 15 in line). Also Wed 9/23 2-4 PM and Wed 10/7 11:48 AM.
stores.tip: Ignore a morning 'no Pokemon' - on 10/13 the vendor said that and came back ~4 PM.

stores.name: Carrollwood Target
stores.pattern: Thursday/Friday at open: Fri 9/25 (vendor 6:35 AM), Thu 10/1 (by 9 AM), Fri 10/9 (AM), Fri 10/16 (~8 AM). Fridays three of the last four weeks; tends to come the day after Lutz.
stores.tip: Campers start after midnight (first person 12:40 AM, 13 by 4:47 AM, ~18 by 7:22 on 10/16). 30th gone within ~15 min of open - be in the first ~10.

stores.name: Uni Target
stores.pattern: Wednesday and Friday mornings: Wed 10/14 at open (posters, mini tins) and Fri 10/16 (Knockouts, AH blisters, Poke Ball tins). Employees have said Wed & Fri. Earlier: Mon 9/28 behind CS.
stores.tip: Stock is held behind customer service - ask CS. Light stock so far; no ETBs reported here this week.

stores.name: Target 275
stores.pattern: Mondays, four weeks running: Mon 9/28 (vendor, back wall ~9-9:45 AM), Mon 10/5 (quiet AM stock, no callout), Mon 10/12 (vendor ~2:28 PM, 30th, OOS ~3:45), Mon 10/19 (vendor ~1:30 PM, 8 ex boxes, OOS 3:25). Day is reliable; time is not - anywhere from mid-morning to mid-afternoon.
stores.window: Mon 10/26 - the last two were early afternoon (~1:30-2:30 PM)
stores.tip: Product goes to the back wall. People have hidden stock here; staff trespassed hiders on 9/28. Limit 1 per person on 30th bundles (enforced at checkout).

stores.name: Hillsborough Super Target
stores.pattern: One clear regular stock seen (Wed 10/7 at open). May be the same store as West Hills Target - members use both names.
stores.tip: Treat as Wednesday-morning store until more data.

stores.name: BBD Target
stores.pattern: Only one secondhand regular restock (Tue 9/29) plus release day.
stores.tip: Thin data - check on a Tuesday if you're nearby.

stores.name: BBD Walmart
stores.pattern: Wednesday at open, three weeks running (9/30, 10/7, 10/14 - staff stocking ~7 AM). Also Tuesday afternoons 9/22 and 9/29. Never seen on a Tuesday morning.
stores.tip: 20ish in line on 10/14 - get there by ~6:30.

stores.name: Fletcher Walmart
stores.pattern: Wednesdays: 9/30 and 10/7 early morning (first vendor stop), but 10/14 at ~2:11 PM after Gandy Walmart. Also Fri 9/25.
stores.window: Wed - check ~7-9 AM; if nothing, ~1-3 PM
stores.tip: Rarely called out; 30th gone within ~40 min on 10/14.

stores.pattern: Wed/Thu: Thu 9/24 2:44 PM, Wed 9/30 PM, Wed 10/7 3:19 PM, Thu 10/15 early AM (30th OOS by 9:50).
stores.tip: Same vendor route as Fletcher/Nebraska/Gandy Walmart.

stores.name: Nebraska Walmart
stores.pattern: Thursday ~9 AM: 9/24, 10/1, 10/15 (vendor pulled up 9:01). Once Wed 10/7 ~12:55 PM. Vendor takes 1-1.5 hrs.

stores.name: Gandy Walmart
stores.pattern: Wednesdays/Thursdays: Wed 9/23 11 AM, Thu 10/1 1:36 PM, Wed 10/7 12:55 PM, Wed 10/14 9:25 AM.

stores.name: Carrollwood Sam's
stores.pattern: Thursdays, four in a row (9/24, 10/1, 10/8, 10/15), ~10:15 AM-1 PM, plus a follow-up 1-2 days later (Fri 10/2, Fri 10/9, Sat 10/17 at open). When the manager holds a pallet because of a crowd (Fri 10/16), it went out at opening the next morning.
stores.window: Thu 10/22, be inside ~10 AM-1:30 PM; watch Fri/Sat at open for the follow-up
stores.tip: Reportedly out of Focused Fighters; 2 more ETB bundle pallets in back (10/19 report). No drop Mon 10/19. Lurkers make the manager hold stock - if Thursday is crowded, try opening the next day.

stores.name: WC Sam's
stores.pattern: Afternoons, ~1:30-3:30 PM: Fri 9/25, Thu 10/1, Fri 10/2, Thu 10/15 (~3:15), Fri 10/16 (~2:59, OOS 3:10), Sat 10/17 (~2:03) - three days in a row, 6 FF pallets total. Average ~2:40 PM. Two drops this week after a two-week gap.
stores.tip: If area stores got ~6 pallets of FF in total (your read), WC has now done 6 - likely out of FF; next should be the ETB + Poke Ball pallet. Drops when no one is camping - wait in the car, not inside. Gone in ~13-35 min.

stores.name: Brandon Sam's
stores.pattern: FF drops: Mon 9/21, Tue 9/22 ~10:15 AM, Sat 9/26 ~11 AM, Mon 9/28 ~1 PM, Fri 10/9 ~1:30 PM, Mon 10/19 ~1:08 PM (6 total; + possibly Sat 10/3). New manager (Pedro) started 10/19 and dropped on day one. Members say ~1 FF pallet left, then the ETB pallets.
stores.window: Any day this week ~1-2 PM; first ETB pallet still to come
stores.tip: Afternoons around 1 PM lately (9/28, 10/9, 10/19). New manager may move faster now. A pallet is gone in ~15-25 min from the drop.

stores.name: Riverview Sam's
stores.pattern: FF drops: Tue 9/22 ~8 AM, Fri 9/25 ~10:20 AM, Thu 10/1 ~1:35 PM, Fri 10/2 ~11:54 AM, Thu 10/8 ~2:11 PM, Fri 10/9 ~9:26 AM (+ possibly 9/20, 9/28). ETB + Poke Ball pallets: Fri 10/16 ~2:12 PM, Tue 10/20 ~2:00 PM. Last three drops all ~2 PM. Never more than one pallet a day.
stores.tip: Near your work off 78th St - a 2 PM drop is reachable on a break. Sells out in ~15-35 min. Not again today (one pallet a day).

stores.name: Clearwater Sam's
stores.pattern: Thursday-Saturday, ~12:30-2 PM: Thu 9/24 ~1:04, Fri 9/25 ~1:01, Sat 9/26 (OOS 12:42), Sat 10/3 ~1:55, Fri 10/9 ~1:19. Never seen on a Monday or after 2 PM. Staff told callers they drop 'randomly with no notice'.
stores.tip: Sells out in ~20 min. People camp it all day, so be inside by ~12:15.

stores.name: Carrollwood Barnes
stores.address: 13123 N Dale Mabry Hwy (Palms of Carrollwood) - aka Northdale / BN Carol
stores.pattern: Employees put stock out at open, mostly Tue/Wed: Tue 9/15, Wed 9/16, Tue 9/29, Tue 10/6 (30-40 30th ETBs), Wed 10/21 (bundles, ETBs, ex boxes); also Thu 10/15 (Knockouts) and Sat 10/3 (30th). Members call it the most consistent store in Tampa right now.
stores.window: Tue 10/27 or Wed 10/28 at open (~10 AM); line by 8:30
stores.tip: 2 per SKU. Lines run 5-15 by open. Ask staff the day before if a box came in. B&N rewards saves $5.

stores.name: Brandon Barnes
stores.address: W Brandon Blvd, next to Brandon Best Buy
stores.pattern: Tue/Wed at 10 AM open: Wed 9/16, Tue 9/22, Wed 9/30, Wed 10/7, Tue 10/13, Tue 10/20; also Sat 10/3 (tins + bundles). Usually one box per shipment.
stores.window: Tue 10/27 or Wed 10/28 at 10 AM open
stores.tip: One box, 2 per SKU, but lines hit 20-40 (ghost chairs from ~6 AM). BN Brandon posts on Facebook/Instagram when product arrives.

stores.name: Westshore Barnes
stores.pattern: Small store, sporadic: Wed 9/16, Sat 10/3 (tins + bundles), Mon 10/19 (roundup), plus small/secondhand drops Fri 9/25 and Sat 10/17. Staff say they rarely get much.
stores.tip: Members call it 'never worth it'; manager says no weekend deliveries. Only worth a stop if you're already at Westshore.
